kept_items.author: sama
kept_items.text: 5.6 livestream going now. in addition to the model, 3 major product things: 1. ChatGPT Work--really big deal! 2. new ChatGPT desktop app 3. hosted sites
kept_items.selection_reason: Altman announcing the GPT-5.6 launch and three major product releases; the day's anchor story.

kept_items.author: OpenAI
kept_items.text: Introducing ChatGPT Work, a new agent in ChatGPT powered by Codex and GPT-5.6. It can take action across your apps and files, stay with a project for hours if needed.
kept_items.selection_reason: Primary product announcement of ChatGPT Work agent; highest-reach official post.

kept_items.author: OpenAIDevs
kept_items.text: We're bringing Codex and ChatGPT together in one desktop app. New coding workflows, a new Chrome extension, revamped in-app browser, and faster Computer Use powered by GPT-5.6.
kept_items.selection_reason: Distinct developer-facing detail: unified Codex/ChatGPT desktop app and Computer Use.

kept_items.author: sama
kept_items.text: we have heard enterprises on their concerns about AI costs, and 5.6 sol is a huge step forward for dollars-per-task, as are terra and luna.
kept_items.selection_reason: Frames the GPT-5.6 family around dollars-per-task and enterprise cost, a distinct angle from the product launch.

kept_items.author: finkd
kept_items.text: Today we're releasing Muse Spark 1.1 -- a strong agentic and coding model at a very low price. It's available through our new Meta Model API and in Meta AI.
kept_items.selection_reason: Zuckerberg releasing Muse Spark 1.1 and a new Meta Model API; major competing model launch.

kept_items.author: elonmusk
kept_items.text: I was clearly wrong about Anthropic. They are obviously currently the leader in AI. No company has released a model as good as Mythos/Fable. And I would never cut them off in a way that hurt them badly.
kept_items.selection_reason: Musk publicly calls Anthropic the AI leader and disavows cutting off its compute; high-signal company/competitive move.

kept_items.author: yacineMTB
kept_items.text: SpaceXAI now has a legitimate frontier model that competes with opus 4.8. Also, Anthropic is completely reliant on the compute rented from SpaceXAI. If Elon wanted to kill anthropic, he could.
kept_items.selection_reason: Widely-shared claim about Anthropic's compute dependence on SpaceXAI; context for the Musk post.

kept_items.author: claudeai
kept_items.text: Introducing a new way to reflect on how you use Claude. Your monthly recap shows when you use Claude most and what you spent that time working on, with options to set quiet hours and nudges to take breaks.
kept_items.selection_reason: Anthropic ships a usage-reflection/wellbeing feature (Reflect); concrete product news.

kept_items.author: sama
kept_items.text: i am really sad about this and very grateful for all fidji has done for openai, and even grateful for her friendship. we all wish her the best for a speedy recovery.
kept_items.selection_reason: Altman on Fidji Simo's health and departure context; notable company/personnel news.

kept_items.author: AnthropicAI
kept_items.text: Our Long-Term Benefit Trust has appointed Dr. Ben Bernanke as its newest member.
kept_items.selection_reason: Anthropic governance move: former Fed chair Ben Bernanke joins its Long-Term Benefit Trust.

kept_items.author: perplexity_ai
kept_items.text: GPT-5.6 Terra and Sol are now available in Perplexity and Perplexity Computer.
kept_items.selection_reason: Third-party distribution: GPT-5.6 models land in Perplexity same day, showing rapid ecosystem uptake.

kept_items.author: StanfordAILab
kept_items.text: Verification has emerged as a new scaling axis. LLM-as-a-Verifier shows that scaling verification can push performance to SOTA across Terminal-Bench V2, SWE-Bench Verified, RoboRewardBench, and MedAgentBench.
kept_items.selection_reason: Research result framing verification as a new scaling axis; useful technical analysis distinct from the product news.
